title: Gretchen Gifts of Love Figurine 1979 WWA Designers Collection Boy Girl on Bench
conditionDescription: Pre-owned with no chips, cracks or repairs found. Original store price sticker still on the underside.
descriptionText:
"Gifts of Love" from the Gretchen Collection, Series I - one of four designs, by WWA Inc. (Designers Collection), Cleveland, Ohio, dated MCMLXXIX (1979) on the base. Bisque porcelain figurine of a boy in a straw hat and brown overalls sitting on a wooden bench beside a girl in a yellow bonnet and pinafore holding a little bouquet, on an oval grassy base with painted flowers. Soft matte hand-painted colors in the Holly Hobbie / Betsey Clark style. About 5 inches tall.

Condition: Pre-owned with no chips, cracks or repairs found. Original store price sticker ($31.50) still on the underside. Please review all photos - they are of the actual figurine you will receive.
